does_not_do: Its centre is optimization, producing weights, rather than reporting on an existing portfolio; it publishes to PyPI, not GitHub releases.
focus_reason: Its risk measures and risk parity tools can describe concentration and volatility, but they are reached through an optimization API. 9 open issues; 6 versions in the year.
measured_against: Need: measure concentration, volatility and drawdown of a portfolio from its holdings or returns, in code the user runs.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory; CI workflows build the package and the documentation.
what_it_is: A portfolio optimization library on CVXPY and pandas, with mean-risk and risk parity optimization over many convex risk measures and hierarchical methods (HRP, HERC).
